parsing_res_list.block_content: 3.4. Effects of Process Parameters on Damage to Coating on the Sharp Angle Side of Holes

The micrograph of damage on the sharp edge of the air-hole coating under different processing parameters is shown in Figure 12. Conversely, the air hole with a pulse energy of 30 W and a scanning speed of 80 mm/s
shows the poorest quality, with a large area of damage.
